item.title: People inside Microsoft are fighting to drop mandatory Microsoft Account
item.description:
📝 It's all great news, but there's one big issue that Microsoft notably isn't addressing with these sweeping changes, and that's Windows 11's forced Microsoft account requirements. In fact, the blog post Microsoft published doesn't mention Microsoft accounts at all. "I understand that Hanselman isn't the only person at Microsoft who doesn't like the forced Microsoft account requirements, and that there are a number of people internally that are pushing to relax this.
